intro: The Sleepers' Key is one of three enchanted keys crafted by night elf druids to seal their sacred vault within the Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak. Kept safe inside a hidden cache locked by the Gatekeeper's Key, it represents the slumbering druids of the wild who guard the mountain's deepest secrets.

p: Carved into the heights of Stonetalon Peak, the Talon Den serves as a redoubt and sanctum for the druids of Kalimdor. Aware that their sacred relics and potent treasures might draw unwanted attention, the night elf keepers devised an intricate system of locks and hidden caches to protect their hoard. The Sleepers' Key is one third of that protective ward. Placed within a secluded cache in the den's depths, it can only be retrieved using the Gatekeeper's Key hidden near the threshold. Alongside the Claw Key and the Barrow Key, the Sleepers' Key must be set into the stone locks of the Talon Den Hoard to disperse the ward and reveal the ancient items held within.
